commercial_product.summary: Labcorp operates two reporting segments: Labcorp Diagnostics (clinical lab testing across routine, esoteric, and specialty areas) and Labcorp Biopharma Laboratory Services (central labs, companion diagnostics, and biomarker services for pharma sponsors).

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Distribution / services company — no proprietary clinical pipeline. Labcorp is a diagnostics laboratory operator and contract research / central-lab services provider; clinical trials in which Labcorp is named are sponsor-funded (pharma or device companies) and Labcorp owns no IND-stage molecular entity in P1/P2/P3.
